name: 86 Chaos 16.0.65 Mobile No-Zoom Guard Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.65 Mobile No-Zoom Guard Fix
notes: Mobile browsers are now locked to the app viewport with maximum-scale/user-scalable settings.
The existing mobile no-zoom guard is installed at app startup to block pinch and double-tap zoom gestures on phones.
Inputs keep 16px mobile font sizing so focusing fields does not trigger browser zoom.
